verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a managed cloud data warehouse, and whether its source is open is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no open-source license and no public source code for the MotherDuck service. The only GitHub reference is the separate local MCP server (motherduckdb/mcp-server-motherduck), with no license stated, which is an adjacent component rather than the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
